project_title: 基于轻量化深度学习与运动补偿的钢轨表面缺陷实时检测方法研究
implementation: Project implementation of the mature architecture using public MATLAB layer APIs; not the vendor constructor or author bitwise reproduction
image_normalization: single(uint8_image)/255 once; image input Normalization none
support_package_policy: Use public mobilenetv2 with Weights none; do not download pretrained weights or invoke private vendor functions
small_input_limit: At output stride16 the high-level map is16x16; the rate18 3x3 branch has padding-only noncentral samples. This is a fixed limited-input comparison, not the architecture's best published setting.
optimization_scope: Shared project recipe is not per-model hyperparameter optimization
